test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All hens are dogs.

All dogs are peacocks.

**Conclusions:**

I. All hens are peacocks.

II. All peacocks are dogs.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

All hens are dogs.

All dogs are peacocks.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bd435259b801b826dcf10381132da31cff4cace843e05f08abf0220547347b5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/086f25ccdd857fb428cacd80b3a2719c029f51d09a7e76ccc2b923d6d222b4c5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All hens are peacocks. - **True **(because All hens are dogs and All dogs are peacocks. So, All hens are peacocks too)

II. All peacocks are dogs. - **False **(because All dogs are peacocks given. So, All peacocks are dogs it is not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**
